title: Sign in to Skyclause
heading: Sign in
heading_sign_up: Sign in or create your account
lead: Your windows, their calls and the ledger are inside.
lead_sign_up: One email link creates your account, then signs you in each time after.
next_reason: Sign in to open the page you asked for.
email_hint: New to Skyclause? The same link creates your account.
email_invalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.

use_other.passkey_google: Use a passkey or Google instead.

sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.

resent: Another link is on its way.

google_failed: Google sign-in didn’t finish. Try Google again or use email sign-in.

send_rate_limited: Too many link requests. Wait a while, then try again.
